# Frame fixtures

Recorded frames of ZET GTFS-Realtime (https://www.zet.hr/gtfs-rt-protobuf, the `zet-rt` source of `docs/izvori.md`), recorded by the twin (`worker/twin/record.ts`) into R2, pulled into a local `recordings/` copy that is never committed, and cut with `scripts/frames-sample.mjs` (`npm run frames:sample`). ZET publishes the feed under the Croatian Open Licence (Otvorena dozvola); attribution, verbatim: "Public dataset by ZET provided under Open license, dataset source http://www.zet.hr/odredbe/datoteke-u-gtfs-formatu/669". Test fixtures only: the Worker never serves them and no client downloads them.

Each directory's README.md is generated by the script (edit the script, not the file) and states the window in UTC and in Zagreb time, the filter, the counts, the feed the trips join and the exact cut command. Directory names carry the UTC date of the file names and a clock window: the two 21 September samples name the Zagreb window (17:15 is 15:15Z), the strike samples the UTC window (`2026-09-27-2200-2330-collapse` is 00:00 to 01:30 Zagreb on 28 September).

| Directory | Frames | Bytes (`.pb`) | Window, UTC | Window, Zagreb | Filter | Trips join | What it pins |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `2026-09-21-1715-1744` | 162 | 6,177,707 | 21 Sep 15:15:00 to 15:44:59 | 21 Sep 17:15 to 17:44 | tram only | 000395 | the wrong-turn acceptance (`test/accept/wrong-turn.test.ts`, `npm run replay:grade`) |
| `2026-09-21-1715-1717-all` | 11 | 1,008,495 | 21 Sep 15:15:00 to 15:17:00 | 21 Sep 17:15 to 17:17 | all modes | 000395 | ZET's CANCELED trips and NO_SERVICE alerts on a normal day (upgrade pass U1-1) |
| `2026-09-27-2200-2330-collapse` | 179, every 3rd of 535 | 842,322 | 27 Sep 22:00 to 23:30 | 28 Sep 00:00 to 01:30 | all modes | 000395 | deviation: the fleet collapse as the strike began (U2 A4) |
| `2026-09-28-0100-0230-start` | 499 | 267,295 | 28 Sep 01:00 to 02:30 | 28 Sep 03:00 to 04:30 | all modes | 000396 | deviation: the official start of the strike (U2 A4) |
| `2026-09-28-0530-0630-peak` | 332 | 151,570 | 28 Sep 05:30 to 06:30 | 28 Sep 07:30 to 08:30 | all modes | 000396 | deviation: the first strike morning's peak (U2 A4) |

The three strike samples are deviation fixtures of the ZET general strike of 28 to 29 September 2026: the first line of each README says so, and none of them is ever a normal-behaviour replay, tuning or fixture day. `branches-0921-aggregates.json` is the grader's aggregate of the whole of 21 September (`test/scripts/grade-branches.test.ts`), not frames.

## Still to cut

`2026-09-29-0310-0330-onebus`, Tuesday 29 September from 05:10 to 05:30 Zagreb: the feed a bare header until bus 330 (Velika Gorica) reports at 05:18:58 Zagreb, the one vehicle to the end of the window (read from 30-second samples; check the counts in the generated README before committing). R2 keeps the frames for seven days, so pull the day before 6 October, then run from the repository root:

```
node scripts/frames-sample.mjs <recordings>/2026/09/29 --from 031000 --to 033000 --out test/fixtures/frames/2026-09-29-0310-0330-onebus --all-modes --lead 'Deviation fixture: the ZET general strike of 28 to 29 September 2026. Never a normal-behaviour replay, tuning or fixture day.' --use 'Written for U2 acceptance A4 (`test/accept/service-state.test.ts`, added by U2): the one bus of the second strike night, Tuesday 29 September from 05:10 to 05:30 Zagreb at full cadence. The feed carries no vehicle until bus 330 (Velika Gorica) reports at 05:18:58 Zagreb, and it stays the only one to the end of the window; the service state must stay `silent`. The trips are service 0_30 of feed 000396. The strike cannot be recorded again: never re-cut this window from another day, and keep the artefacts of its feed with the tests that replay it.'
```
